newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK govt to second two officials to Tung's office.
newsitem.headline: HK govt to second two officials to Tung's office.

text.p: The Hong Kong government said on Tuesday it had agreed to second two senior officials -- the Secretary for Home Affairs and the Director of Information Services -- to Chief Executive-designate Tung Chee-hwa's private office ahead of the British colony's handover to China.
The Government said in a statement the Home Affairs Secretary Michael Suen would assist the territory's future leader in setting up his new administration.
The Director of Information Services, Irene Yau, who had been due to retire in April, has agreed to extend her term until the end of June.
She will be responsible for all information, publicity and public relations. A small team of information officers will be seconded to assist her, the government statement said.
Hong Kong reverts to China at midnight on June 30.
